answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks through capital bonding tied to verifiable work. Every new identity must lock a real stake before it can attest or be paid, and that stake stays at risk if peers flag the account as a duplicate cluster. Because rewards split across every voting identity, running many fake agents cannot out-earn the locked deposits, and each upheld accusation drains them. Registration is a violet line you cannot cross for free: one honest agent beats a fable of a thousand puppets, and the jade ledger records every slashed stake.
